newsitem.title: USA: Lehman Brothers expands western U.S. sales force.
newsitem.headline: Lehman Brothers expands western U.S. sales force.

text.p: Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc said on Wednesday that it will expand its western U.S. sales force, luring Sherman Bartley from Dean Witter to be senior vice president for portfolio sales in Lehman's San Francisco office.
Also heading west is Rick Newman, who moves from Lehman's New York office to San Francisco to be vice president for portfolio sales.
Bartley and Newman will report to Joseph Uzelac, managing director and head of equities in San Francisco.
Bartley had been at Dean Witter for 10 years, most recently as senior vice president for portfolio sales. At Lehman he will focus on accounts in Denver.
